question: 11. When you smile at ____________, does he/she smile back at you?

ask_no_followup.text: What makes ____________ smile? (If parent does not give a 0 example below, ask each individually.)

pass_examples.instruction:
Does your child...
(Below are pass examples)
items: Smile when you enter the room?
Smile when you return from being away?
Smile at a favorite toy or activity?
Smile randomly or at nothing in particular?

clarify_frequency.text: Which one does he/she do most often?
